changes.speaker: Misumaru
changes.old_en: Soon, the Federation's Far East Forces and TERRA, the anti-MU strategic research agency, will launch a major operation.
changes.en: Soon, the Federation's Far East Forces and TERRA, the anti-Mu strategic research agency, will launch a major operation.

changes.speaker: Koji
changes.old_en: Damn it... Is MU about to start another invasion...?!
changes.en: Damn it... Is Mu about to start another invasion...?!

changes.speaker: Beecha
changes.old_en: Sure, but I want to see for myself what those MU Dolems, or doughnuts, or whatever they're called, can do.
changes.en: Sure, but I want to see for myself what those Mu Dolems, or doughnuts, or whatever they're called, can do.

changes.speaker: Kunugi
changes.old_en: Yes. TERRA is an anti-MU strategy research agency. We investigate why MU invaded and develop countermeasures.
changes.en: Yes. TERRA is an anti-Mu strategy research agency. We investigate why Mu invaded and develop countermeasures.

changes.speaker: Haruka
changes.old_en: The people inside it only identified themselves as MU. They never responded to our attempts to contact them.
changes.en: The people inside it only identified themselves as Mu. They never responded to our attempts to contact them.

changes.speaker: Haruka
changes.old_en: Then humanity was overwhelmed by the nightmare it had imagined, and launched an attack on MU's floating city...
changes.en: Then humanity was overwhelmed by the nightmare it had imagined, and launched an attack on Mu's floating city...

changes.speaker: Ayato
changes.old_en: What did MU do?
changes.en: What did Mu do?

changes.speaker: Haruka
changes.old_en: And in just one day, city after city was annihilated. As humanity braced for an all-out war with MU...
changes.en: And in just one day, city after city was annihilated. As humanity braced for an all-out war with Mu...

changes.speaker: Haruka
changes.old_en: Suddenly, a spherical dimensional barrier covered Tokyo, and MU shut themselves inside it.
changes.en: Suddenly, a spherical dimensional barrier covered Tokyo, and Mu shut themselves inside it.

changes.speaker: Shi-Aen
changes.old_en: No, I ask that Briest of the Fires and...
changes.en: No, I ask that Bryst of the Fires and...

changes.speaker: Bahbem
changes.old_en: They are ideal for buying time... No, as decoys to draw our gaze and the enemy to them.
changes.en: They're ideal for stalling... No, as decoys to draw our attention and lure the enemy.

changes.speaker: Dr. Inoue
changes.old_en: Yes. They've been researching and analyzing the MU for some time, so their technology is highly advanced.
changes.en: Yes. They've been researching and analyzing the Mu for some time, so their technology is highly advanced.

changes.speaker: Ryoma
changes.old_en: And on Earth, there's the Hyakki Empire, Hau Dragon... and MU too.
changes.en: And on Earth, there's the Hyakki Empire, Hau Dragon... and Mu too.

changes.speaker: Prospector
changes.old_en: Giganos, Gulfer, MU... The Hyakki Empire and Tekkoryu... Then the Vegan Empire, and on top of that, the Angels.
changes.en: Giganos, Gulfer, Mu... The Hyakki Empire and Tekkoryu... Then the Vegan Empire, and on top of that, the Angels.

changes.speaker: Luhran
changes.old_en: Twin Lord uses Briest of the Fires' Plasma Bullet Magrash and...
changes.en: Twin Lord uses Bryst of the Fires' Plasma Bullet Magrash and...

changes.speaker: Shi-Tau
changes.old_en: You call it teamwork... But isn't my Gallowin just there to support your Briest?
changes.en: You call it teamwork... But isn't my Gallowin just there to support your Bryst?

changes.speaker: Shi-Tau
changes.old_en: with Briest's Magrash delivering the finishing blow... My sister attacks the target, and all I do is support her...!
changes.en: with Bryst's Magrash delivering the finishing blow... My sister attacks the target, and all I do is support her...!

changes.speaker: Shi-Aen
changes.old_en: Tau! Transfer all of Gallowin's energy to Briest!
changes.en: Tau! Transfer all of Gallowin's energy to Bryst!

changes.speaker: Shi-Tau
changes.old_en: Sister... If I transfer the power to Briest, this Gallowin won't be able to move.
changes.en: Sister... If I transfer the power to Bryst, this Gallowin won't be able to move.

changes.old_en: In that incident... wasn't MU attempting to make direct contact with the EVA-01 pilot?
changes.en: In that incident... wasn't Mu attempting to make direct contact with the EVA-01 pilot?

changes.old_en: Didn't MU use the Dolem to look into the EVA-01 pilot's memories?
changes.en: Didn't Mu use the Dolem to look into the EVA-01 pilot's memories?

changes.speaker: Misato
changes.old_en: Why did MU make contact with the EVA?
changes.en: Why did Mu make contact with the EVA?

changes.speaker: Misato
changes.old_en: As I thought, there's some connection between EVA and MU...
changes.en: As I thought, there's some connection between EVA and Mu...

changes.speaker: Helena
changes.old_en: It is an anti-MU weapon... a mobile weapon built to provide TERRA with a new fighting force.
changes.en: It is an anti-Mu weapon... a mobile weapon built to provide TERRA with a new fighting force.

changes.speaker: Elvy
changes.old_en: Then I can fight the MU without relying on RahXephon or Kamina...!
changes.en: Then I can fight the Mu without relying on RahXephon or Kamina...!

changes.speaker: Elvy
changes.old_en: Fine, I'll do it. When I settle things with the MU, I'll have to face much worse than this anyway.
changes.en: Fine, I'll do it. When I settle things with the Mu, I'll have to face much worse than this anyway.

changes.speaker: Isshiki
changes.old_en: TERRA is a strategic organization for fighting the MU. It was not created to fight monsters like that.
changes.en: TERRA is a strategic organization for fighting the Mu. It was not created to fight monsters like that.

changes.speaker: Elvy
changes.old_en: Hey! Did Kamina show a MU phase response!? Are you saying he's a Mulian!?
changes.en: Hey! Did Kamina show a Mu phase response!? Are you saying he's a Mulian!?

changes.speaker: Haruka
changes.old_en: You don't have to worry... MU or human, it doesn't matter. Really...
changes.en: You don't have to worry... Mu or human, it doesn't matter. Really...

changes.speaker: Isshiki
changes.old_en: Your surprise is understandable. However, his blood has already tested positive for MU.
changes.en: Your surprise is understandable. However, his blood has already tested positive for Mu.

changes.speaker: Futagami
changes.old_en: The former Demon Empire, perhaps? Or MU?
changes.en: The former Demon Empire, perhaps? Or Mu?

changes.speaker: Isshiki
changes.old_en: Then we will send an assault force led by #部隊名 into Tokyo... and subdue MU in one decisive strike.
changes.en: Then we will send an assault force led by #部隊名 into Tokyo... and subdue Mu in one decisive strike.

changes.speaker: Quattro
changes.old_en: EVA and Raideen... And MU and RahXephon... The fate of this world...
changes.en: EVA and Raideen... And Mu and RahXephon... The fate of this world...

changes.speaker: Kim
changes.old_en: A MU aerial city has appeared above New York!!
changes.en: A Mu aerial city has appeared above New York!!

changes.speaker: Kim
changes.old_en: MU aerial cities appear to be emerging one after another above cities around the world!!
changes.en: Mu aerial cities appear to be emerging one after another above cities around the world!!

changes.speaker: Soichi
changes.old_en: MU is multiplying...!?
changes.en: Mu is multiplying...!?

changes.speaker: Misato
changes.old_en: Former Colonel Masayoshi Kuki of the Far East Command...! Wasn't he reported missing after the outbreak of the MU War...!?
changes.en: Former Colonel Masayoshi Kuki of the Far East Command...! Wasn't he reported missing after the outbreak of the Mu War...!?

changes.speaker: Haruka
changes.old_en: No, he was inside the absolute barrier. As commander of the MU Government-General's Defense Force...!
changes.en: No, he was inside the absolute barrier. As commander of the Mu Government-General's Defense Force...!

changes.speaker: Duke
changes.old_en: Does he mean MU will launch an all-out attack...?
changes.en: Does he mean Mu will launch an all-out attack...?

changes.speaker: Ruri
changes.old_en: Are you sure? If this goes badly, the MU above every city may start attacking, you know.
changes.en: Are you sure? If this goes badly, the Mu above every city may start attacking, you know.

changes.speaker: Kuki
changes.old_en: Stop your futile resistance and meekly accept MU's judgment.
changes.en: Stop your futile resistance and meekly accept Mu's judgment.

changes.speaker: Misato
changes.old_en: Don't tell me it's MU!?
changes.en: Don't tell me it's Mu!?

changes.speaker: Kunugi
changes.old_en: The chaos caused by the appearance of MU's aerial cities gives other enemy organizations a perfect opportunity...
changes.en: The chaos caused by the appearance of Mu's aerial cities gives other enemy organizations a perfect opportunity...

changes.speaker: Futagami
changes.old_en: Yes. Probably because they're under MU's mind control.
changes.en: Yes. Probably because they're under Mu's mind control.

changes.speaker: Rikudo
changes.old_en: If Quon makes contact with MU again, it too will be like Ayato's RahXephon...
changes.en: If Quon makes contact with Mu again, it too will be like Ayato's RahXephon...

changes.speaker: Chief Shibuya
changes.old_en: Damn the Hyakki Empire! They're exploiting the chaos caused by the MU!
changes.en: Damn the Hyakki Empire! They're exploiting the chaos caused by the Mu!

changes.speaker: Amuro
changes.old_en: The absolute barrier has vanished, and the MU have appeared. The whole world is in chaos.
changes.en: The absolute barrier has vanished, and the Mu have appeared. The whole world is in chaos.

changes.speaker: Bright
changes.old_en: Yes. We must defeat them before the MU, the Giganos remnants or the Martian Successors make their move.
changes.en: Yes. We must defeat them before the Mu, the Giganos remnants or the Martian Successors make their move.

changes.speaker: Dorchenov
changes.old_en: You can deal a fatal blow to the Earth Federation and its forces, already in chaos over the MU's airborne cities.
changes.en: You can deal a fatal blow to the Earth Federation and its forces, already in chaos over the Mu's airborne cities.

changes.speaker: Kusakabe
changes.old_en: The Earth Sphere now faces an unprecedented crisis, threatened by outside enemies such as MU and Gulfer!
changes.en: The Earth Sphere now faces an unprecedented crisis, threatened by outside enemies such as Mu and Gulfer!

changes.speaker: Min
changes.old_en: MU's floating cities... I've heard about those and Gulfer too.
changes.en: Mu's floating cities... I've heard about those and Gulfer too.

changes.speaker: Ben
changes.old_en: It seems we were fortunate that MU has made no move.
changes.en: It seems we were fortunate that Mu has made no move.

changes.speaker: Fuyutsuki
changes.old_en: That leaves MU, Gulfer, the Devil Gundam... and the Angels.
changes.en: That leaves Mu, Gulfer, the Devil Gundam... and the Angels.

changes.speaker: Gendo
changes.old_en: How are MU's floating cities... the Hiranipra?
changes.en: How are Mu's floating cities... the Hiranipra?

changes.speaker: Misato
changes.old_en: There is still no change. The whereabouts of Maya Kamina and the other suspected MU leaders remain unknown.
changes.en: There is still no change. The whereabouts of Maya Kamina and the other suspected Mu leaders remain unknown.

changes.speaker: Gendo
changes.old_en: ...How long until the MU world completely merges with our side?
changes.en: ...How long until the Mu world completely merges with our side?

changes.speaker: Futagami
changes.old_en: You mean it is more likely to be MU?
changes.en: You mean it is more likely to be Mu?

changes.speaker: Dr. Hibiki
changes.old_en: Since MU appeared over a decade ago, I have been investigating their connection to the ancient Mu Empire...
changes.en: Since Mu appeared over a decade ago, I have been investigating their connection to the ancient Mu Empire...

changes.speaker: Futagami
changes.old_en: So, in the end... you still don't really know how Raideen, RahXephon and MU are connected?
changes.en: So, in the end... you still don't really know how Raideen, RahXephon and Mu are connected?

changes.speaker: Asuka
changes.old_en: You mean merging with the MU world...!?
changes.en: You mean merging with the Mu world...!?

changes.speaker: Makoto
changes.old_en: The source is reliable. I think they're probably meant to counter MU...
changes.en: The source is reliable. I think they're probably meant to counter Mu...

changes.speaker: #男愛称
changes.old_en: That leaves Gulfer, the Devil Gundam and MU as our enemies.
changes.en: That leaves Gulfer, the Devil Gundam and Mu as our enemies.

changes.speaker: Elvy
changes.old_en: Did you forget? Once our world and the MU world become one, everything will be over.
changes.en: Did you forget? Once our world and the Mu world become one, everything will be over.

changes.speaker: Misato
changes.old_en: Does that mean the Human Instrumentality Project is more of a threat to MU than that is?
changes.en: Does that mean the Human Instrumentality Project is more of a threat to Mu than that is?

changes.speaker: Fuyutsuki
changes.old_en: ...Has MU noticed the Fifth's presence?
changes.en: ...Has Mu noticed the Fifth's presence?

changes.speaker: Gendo
changes.old_en: And the MU, who have moved to stop our plan directly...
changes.en: And the Mu, who have moved to stop our plan directly...

changes.speaker: Member A
changes.old_en: ...This has stopped the MU from interfering with us.
changes.en: ...This has stopped the Mu from interfering with us.

changes.speaker: Fuyutsuki
changes.old_en: ...In any case, MU and the Fifth are unwelcome visitors to us...
changes.en: ...In any case, Mu and the Fifth are unwelcome visitors to us...

changes.speaker: Misato
changes.old_en: Then, like the MU... are EVAs and Angels from another world...!?
changes.en: Then, like the Mu... are EVAs and Angels from another world...!?

changes.speaker: Haruka
changes.old_en: And the MU, too...
changes.en: And the Mu, too...

changes.speaker: Michelo
changes.old_en: You bastards know it too, don't you? If MU's floating cities keep multiplying like that, this world will come to an end!
changes.en: You bastards know it too, don't you? If Mu's floating cities keep multiplying like that, this world will come to an end!

changes.speaker: Urube
changes.old_en: MU keeps multiplying, and Gulfer is bringing its homeworld toward Earth! Humanity has no choice but to perish!!
changes.en: Mu keeps multiplying, and Gulfer is bringing its homeworld toward Earth! Humanity has no choice but to perish!!

changes.speaker: Akiyama
changes.old_en: The Earth Sphere is still in chaos over MU. We should keep the fleets here in reserve in case of an emergency.
changes.en: The Earth Sphere is still in chaos over Mu. We should keep the fleets here in reserve in case of an emergency.

changes.speaker: Ginga
changes.old_en: Yeah, I'm worried about the MU guys, too.
changes.en: Yeah, I'm worried about the Mu guys, too.

changes.speaker: Soichi
changes.old_en: ... It'll be all right. Thanks to the Federation forces and our friends, every enemy organization except MU has been neutralized...
changes.en: ... It'll be all right. Thanks to the Federation forces and our friends, every enemy organization except Mu has been neutralized...

changes.speaker: Itsuki
changes.old_en: Long ago, Lord Bahbem acquired twin girls who were Ollins sent into this world by MU.
changes.en: Long ago, Lord Bahbem acquired twin girls who were Ollins sent into this world by Mu.

changes.speaker: Makoto
changes.old_en: Apart from MU... That means we don't have any enemies left.
changes.en: Apart from Mu... That means we don't have any enemies left.

changes.speaker: Makoto
changes.old_en: If Operation Doolittle succeeds, the war with MU will probably drag on... We'd solve their personnel shortage.
changes.en: If Operation Doolittle succeeds, the war with Mu will probably drag on... We'd solve their personnel shortage.

changes.speaker: Fuyutsuki
changes.old_en: On top of that, there's MU's massive offensive... No wonder the elders are impatient.
changes.en: On top of that, there's Mu's massive offensive... No wonder the elders are impatient.

changes.speaker: Shigeru
changes.old_en: Fighting between Federation forces and MU is escalating everywhere. But we haven't confirmed any D1 incursions toward Hakone.
changes.en: Fighting between Federation forces and Mu is escalating everywhere. But we haven't confirmed any D1 incursions toward Hakone.

changes.speaker: Fuyutsuki
changes.old_en: How bold of them... The fighting against MU outside is only escalating.
changes.en: How bold of them... The fighting against Mu outside is only escalating.

changes.speaker: Misato
changes.old_en: What did you say...!? MU is launching an all-out attack outside right now!?
changes.en: What did you say...!? Mu is launching an all-out attack outside right now!?

changes.speaker: Commander Miwa
changes.old_en: Therefore, you are enemies of humanity! Just like those Baam aliens and MU!!
changes.en: Therefore, you are enemies of humanity! Just like those Baam aliens and Mu!!

changes.speaker: Saiga
changes.old_en: Yes... I will be the king who rules the new world! Not SEELE or MU... Me!
changes.en: Yes... I will be the king who rules the new world! Not SEELE or Mu... Me!

rom.english: I have no name to give the likes of you!!
rom.meaning: I refuse to give my name to the likes of you.

bahbem.old_en: They are ideal for buying time... No, as decoys to draw our gaze and the enemy to them.
bahbem.en: They're ideal for stalling... No, as decoys to draw our attention and lure the enemy.
bahbem.meaning: Attract our attention and the enemy; not draw them out.
